initiative.timeline_text: Planned in 2024 in the source document.

source_quote: An agreement to establish an energy cluster between the City of Wroclaw and the rectors of all Wroclaw universities.

initiative.initiative_name: G.1 – Implementing the Green Revolution programme
initiative.general_description: A pathway to expand urban greenery, parks, retention and nature protection through investments and planning.
initiative.objective_text: Implementing the Green Revolution programme.
initiative.implementation_text: Implement Green lungs of Wroclaw and a park in every neighbourhood; eliminate rain and drought hot spots; improve the functioning of water reservoirs; establish ecological sites and natural landscape complexes; afforest the city; add green roofs and facades; revitalise courtyards; protect biodiversity areas; rehabilitate parks and green spaces; create new parks and pocket parks; green streets and block interiors; unseal concreted surfaces; improve rainwater retention; create urban farms; and adopt an ambitious greening plan.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: More green areas, improved retention, biodiversity protection and greener urban spaces.
initiative.delivery_text: City, green-management stakeholders, residents and private property owners.

source_quote: G.1 – Implementing the Green Revolution programme

initiative.initiative_name: G.2 – Education, information, organisational climate action
initiative.general_description: A communication and education pathway to support green infrastructure and climate action.
initiative.objective_text: Education, information, organisational climate action.
initiative.implementation_text: Continue activities within I Like Rain, Catch Rain, Wroclaw Doesn’t Waste, and Bookcrossing.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: Ongoing educational and engagement activities.
initiative.delivery_text: City and residents.

source_quote: G.2 – Education, information, organisational climate action

initiative.initiative_name: Green Lungs of Wroclaw
initiative.general_description: A planned programme for additional parks, urban forests, squares, and recreational green areas.
initiative.objective_text: Increase urban greenery and create more places for rest and recreation among greenery.
initiative.implementation_text: The programme is planned as part of Wroclaw's blue-green infrastructure and climate-adaptation work.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: Additional parks, urban forests, squares, and green recreational areas in Wroclaw.
initiative.delivery_text: City of Wroclaw and blue-green infrastructure stakeholders.

source_quote: Green Lungs of Wroclaw.

initiative.initiative_name: Grey to Green
initiative.general_description: A programme for deconcretising courtyards and squares and replacing sealed surfaces with greenery.
initiative.objective_text: Reduce impervious surfaces and expand climate-resilient urban greenery in Wroclaw.
initiative.implementation_text: The programme continues and expands courtyard and square deconcretisation; a flagship example replaced a concrete city square with nearly 200 trees and 60,000 other plants.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: Deconcretised public spaces with more trees, planting, and climate-adaptive greenery.
initiative.delivery_text: City of Wroclaw and entities involved in public-space greening.

source_quote: Grey to Green.

initiative.initiative_name: I.1 – Decarbonisation of industry
initiative.general_description: A pathway to improve industrial energy efficiency and reduce fossil-fuel dependence in industrial buildings and processes.
initiative.objective_text: Decarbonisation of industry.
initiative.implementation_text: Improve energy efficiency of industrial and manufacturing processes; increase self-sufficiency and energy security through captive electricity and heat production; reduce thermal energy demand; use waste heat; use natural-gas-fired cogeneration; install photovoltaic systems on or near industrial buildings; thermomodernise industrial buildings; and install renewable energy sources for heat production.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: More efficient industrial processes, reduced heat demand and greater use of renewable energy in industry.
initiative.delivery_text: Industry stakeholders, city and industrial property owners.

source_quote: I.1 – Decarbonisation of industry

initiative.initiative_name: Low-emission Zone (participatory process on-going)
initiative.general_description: A participatory process to introduce a clean transportation zone in the city centre and parts of the downtown area.
initiative.objective_text: An introduction of a clean transportation zone for the city centre and parts of the downtown area.
initiative.implementation_text: Led by the Department of Infrastructure and Transportation through a three-stage consultation process covering zone variants, a draft zone for further consultation, a civic meeting stage, and a final public-opinion stage on the draft resolution.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: Deeper awareness of the climate transition and stronger incentives to choose public transportation through a clean transportation zone.
initiative.delivery_text: Led by the public sector at city level through the Department of Infrastructure and Transportation; stakeholders include residents, the private sector, academia, and the third sector.

source_quote: Low-emission Zone (participatory process on-going)

initiative.initiative_name: NEEST (on-going)
initiative.general_description: An ongoing pilot project to develop comprehensive and locally acceptable retrofit models for buildings and neighbourhoods to improve energy efficiency and reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
initiative.objective_text: Project focuses on solutions that will enable comprehensive retrofitting of buildings and neighbourhoods to improve their energy efficiency.
initiative.implementation_text: Led by the Sustainable Development Department in cooperation with the Transition Team; includes systems-thinking and systems-innovation workshops, participatory systems mapping, and co-creation with building managers, housing communities, residents, energy suppliers, and researchers.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: Recommendations on effective, economically efficient, and socially acceptable modernisation of residential and non-residential buildings, plus deeper knowledge and awareness of the climate transition and systemic dependencies.
initiative.delivery_text: Led by the public sector at city level through the Sustainable Development Department in cooperation with the Transition Team; dedicated to stakeholders involved in building energy efficiency, including building managers, housing communities, residents, energy suppliers, and researchers.

source_quote: NEEST (on-going)

initiative.initiative_name: Small RES Programme
initiative.general_description: A municipal renewable-energy programme equipping public facilities and municipal entities with RES installations.
initiative.objective_text: Increase renewable-energy generation on municipal facilities and support municipal climate neutrality.
initiative.implementation_text: The programme equips municipal institutions and public utilities with renewable-energy installations; newly constructed municipal buildings are fitted with photovoltaics, green roofs and walls, and rainwater-management systems.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: More renewable-energy installations on municipal buildings and facilities in Wroclaw.
initiative.delivery_text: City of Wroclaw, municipal institutions, and municipal companies.
initiative.timeline_text: Implemented before the CCC and continued from 2022 onward in the source document.

source_quote: Small RES Programme.

initiative.initiative_name: Sustainable Energy and Climate Action Plan (SECAP)
initiative.general_description: Wroclaw's main energy and climate action plan prepared under the Covenant of Mayors.
initiative.objective_text: Reduce greenhouse gas emissions and promote renewable energy use in Wroclaw.
initiative.implementation_text: Prepared in 2019, the SECAP maps climate risks and vulnerabilities, sets emission reduction scenarios and impact estimates, and identifies key measures for the city.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: A citywide framework for climate mitigation, renewable energy, and adaptation in Wroclaw.
initiative.delivery_text: Municipality of Wroclaw under the Covenant of Mayors framework.
initiative.timeline_text: Prepared in 2019 with targets to 2030 and 2050.

source_quote: Sustainable Energy and Climate Action Plan (2019).

initiative.initiative_name: Sustainable Mobility Plan for the Wroclaw Functional Urban Area (2022)
initiative.general_description: A functional-area mobility plan emphasising public transport, cycling, walking, and lower emissions.
initiative.objective_text: Improve transportation efficiency, reduce congestion, and lower emissions in the Wroclaw Functional Urban Area.
initiative.implementation_text: The plan emphasises public transit, cycling, and walking as core sustainable mobility modes for the broader functional urban area.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: A mobility framework supporting sustainable urban transport across the Wroclaw functional area.
initiative.delivery_text: City of Wroclaw and partners in the Wroclaw Functional Urban Area.
initiative.timeline_text: Adopted in 2022.

source_quote: Sustainable Mobility Plan for the Wroclaw Functional Urban Area (2022).

initiative.initiative_name: T.1 – Development of the public transport network with accompanying infrastructure and reduction of car traffic in the city
initiative.general_description: A transport pathway combining public transport expansion, parking management, tariff integration and shared mobility to reduce car use.
initiative.objective_text: Development of the public transport network with accompanying infrastructure and reduction of car traffic in the city.
initiative.implementation_text: Continue Park&Ride development; expand paid parking; continue zoning of residential areas; integrate tariffs through a common agglomeration ticket; promote carpooling and shared mobility; construct tram and bus programme investments; build new railway stations; add a tram depot and bus depot; and aim to designate a clean transport zone.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: Expanded public transport network, interchange infrastructure, parking management tools, and cleaner transport conditions.
initiative.delivery_text: City, transport operators, residents, private sector and neighbouring municipalities.

source_quote: T.1 – Development of the public transport network with accompanying infrastructure and reduction of car traffic in the city

initiative.initiative_name: T.2 Implementation Plan for Cycling Actions until 2030 for Wroclaw
initiative.general_description: A cycling pathway to expand bicycle parking, routes and cross-border connections.
initiative.objective_text: Implementation Plan for Cycling Actions until 2030 for Wroclaw.
initiative.implementation_text: Create 5,000 new bicycle parking spaces including Bike&Ride; continue and develop Wroclaw City Bicycle; implement or modernise 4 main or alternative routes; add new connections to the cycle route network; modernise 25 km of existing routes; and build 6 new connections to neighbouring municipalities.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: More bicycle parking, upgraded routes and additional cross-municipality cycling links.
initiative.delivery_text: City, cyclists, institutions, workplaces and neighbouring municipalities.

source_quote: T.2 Implementation Plan for Cycling Actions until 2030 for Wroclaw

initiative.initiative_name: T.3 – Implementation of a pedestrian programme (in accordance with the Wroclaw Standards for the Design of Pedestrian Friendly Urban Spaces)
initiative.general_description: A pedestrian-safety and walkability pathway improving crossings, pavements and access routes.
initiative.objective_text: Implementation of a pedestrian programme.
initiative.implementation_text: Improve safety at pedestrian crossings, renovate pavements, and construct new accesses and walkways in accordance with pedestrian-friendly urban space standards.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: Safer crossings, better pavements and new pedestrian connections.
initiative.delivery_text: City and pedestrian infrastructure stakeholders.

source_quote: Action T-3 Implementation of a pedestrian programme (in accordance with Wroclaw standards for shaping pedestrian-friendly urban spaces)

initiative.initiative_name: T.4 - Actions for the dissemination of electric car in individual, collective and commercial transport
initiative.general_description: A pathway to expand EV charging, support electric vehicle uptake, and electrify public transport and fleets.
initiative.objective_text: Actions for the dissemination of electric car in individual, collective and commercial transport.
initiative.implementation_text: Build charging infrastructure for electric and hydrogen vehicles; provide subsidies for electric cars; create facilities for EV users; establish a micro-hub for deliveries; purchase new trams; replace buses with low-emission and zero-emission vehicles; and expand public and commercial charging infrastructure.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: More charging stations, more electric and low-emission vehicles, and supporting EV facilities.
initiative.delivery_text: City, transport operators, property owners, providers and private sector stakeholders.

source_quote: T.4 - Actions for the dissemination of electric car in individual, collective and commercial transport

initiative.initiative_name: T.5 – Education, promotion and information activities in transport
initiative.general_description: A transport-education pathway to promote cycling, walking and electromobility.
initiative.objective_text: Education, promotion and information activities in transport.
initiative.implementation_text: Conduct cycling promotion for various user groups, walking promotion activities, and electromobility education.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: Greater awareness and uptake of sustainable transport choices.
initiative.delivery_text: City, schools, students, entrepreneurs and other transport users.

source_quote: T.5 – Education, promotion and information activities in transport

initiative.initiative_name: Tenement returns
initiative.general_description: A programme for renovating historic tenements and courtyard interiors in Wroclaw.
initiative.objective_text: Accelerate renovation of historic residential stock and improve urban living conditions.
initiative.implementation_text: The city launched the programme to renovate historic tenements, using lessons from NEEST and broader building-modernisation work to improve the housing stock.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: Renovated historic tenements and courtyard interiors across Wroclaw.
initiative.delivery_text: City of Wroclaw and partners involved in historic-building renovation.
initiative.timeline_text: The source document sets targets through 2029.

source_quote: Tenement returns.

initiative.initiative_name: The Strategy for Managing Stormwater and Meltwater in Wroclaw (2023)
initiative.general_description: A city strategy for stormwater and meltwater management in support of climate resilience.
initiative.objective_text: Reduce flood risks and improve sustainable water management in Wroclaw.
initiative.implementation_text: The strategy addresses stormwater and meltwater in the city as part of climate resilience and sustainable urban-water management.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: A city strategy guiding stormwater and meltwater management in Wroclaw.
initiative.delivery_text: City of Wroclaw and urban water-management stakeholders.
initiative.timeline_text: Adopted in 2023.

source_quote: The Strategy for Managing Stormwater and Meltwater in Wroclaw (2023).

initiative.initiative_name: The Wroclaw Tram Program for the years 2024-2032 (2023)
initiative.general_description: A strategic programme for tram expansion and modernisation in Wroclaw.
initiative.objective_text: Reduce congestion and emissions by expanding and modernising tram infrastructure.
initiative.implementation_text: The programme focuses on extending and upgrading tram infrastructure as part of Wroclaw's wider low-emission public-transport strategy.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: A long-term tram investment programme for Wroclaw.
initiative.delivery_text: City of Wroclaw and public-transport infrastructure stakeholders.
initiative.timeline_text: Programme horizon 2024-2032; adopted in 2023.

source_quote: The Wroclaw Tram Program for the years 2024-2032 (2023).

initiative.initiative_name: W.1 – Climate neutrality and energy security of waste and water and sewage management
initiative.general_description: A pathway to improve waste and wastewater systems through R&D, smart systems, recycling, and renewable energy.
initiative.objective_text: Climate neutrality and energy security of waste and water and sewage management.
initiative.implementation_text: Research and develop optimised water treatment and sewage processes; apply intelligent equipment, software and management solutions; improve separate collection; purchase zero- or low-emission vehicles; develop waste treatment installations with energy recovery; conduct circular-economy education; optimise aeration; improve energy efficiency in water and sewage management; increase renewable energy through PV and heat pumps; build organic-waste receiving installations; implement intelligent waste collection and transport management; and use innovative recycling technologies.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: More efficient wastewater and waste systems, higher recycling, energy recovery and lower-emission operations.
initiative.delivery_text: City, waste and water utilities, residents and waste operators.

source_quote: W.1 – Climate neutrality and energy security of waste and water and sewage management

initiative.initiative_name: Wroclaw Participatory Budget
initiative.general_description: A participatory budgeting tool through which residents directly decide how part of the city budget is allocated, including climate-related and green projects.
initiative.objective_text: It is a part of the city's budget, the allocation of which is decided by residents themselves through direct voting.
initiative.implementation_text: Residents submit proposals and vote on projects; the programme includes many green investments such as parks, squares, bicycle and pedestrian paths, and other nature-based solutions, and has included a special green edition.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: Trust-building, stronger cross-sector partnerships, deeper climate-transition awareness, shared ownership of climate action, and support for environmental projects including NBS, clean transportation, education, and light-pollution reduction.
initiative.delivery_text: Led by the Public Participatory Division in cooperation with city divisions reviewing projects and municipal companies implementing them; each project also depends on a local proposal leader and resident voting.

source_quote: Wroclaw Participatory Budget

initiative.initiative_name: Wroclaw Strategy for the Development of Electromobility (2020)
initiative.general_description: A city strategy for electric-vehicle uptake and charging infrastructure development.
initiative.objective_text: Promote electromobility and reduce transport emissions in Wroclaw.
initiative.implementation_text: The strategy frames city action on EV adoption and charging infrastructure as part of transport-sector decarbonisation.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: A city strategy supporting electric vehicles and associated charging infrastructure.
initiative.delivery_text: City of Wroclaw and transport-sector stakeholders.
initiative.timeline_text: Adopted in 2020.

source_quote: Wroclaw Strategy for the Development of Electromobility (2020).

initiative.initiative_name: Wroclaw Transition Team / Municipal Mission Team
initiative.general_description: Wroclaw's cross-sector municipal coordination structure for climate-neutrality work.
initiative.objective_text: Make the city's climate-neutrality work systemic and coordinated across departments, units, and companies.
initiative.implementation_text: The Mayor established the Municipal Mission Team in October 2022; it includes representatives of all city departments, entities, and companies and meets cyclically to ensure information flow and cross-sector cooperation.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: A durable municipal coordination platform for Wroclaw's climate transition.
initiative.delivery_text: Mayor of Wroclaw, city departments, municipal entities, and municipal companies.
initiative.timeline_text: Established in October 2022.

source_quote: Wroclaw Transition Team.

initiative.initiative_name: WROMPA project
initiative.general_description: An innovative wastewater-heat recovery project implemented by district-heating and water utilities in Wroclaw.
initiative.objective_text: Recover heat from wastewater and use it to support district heating in Wroclaw.
initiative.implementation_text: FORTUM Power and Heat Polska and the Municipal Water and Sewerage Company installed one of Europe's largest heat pumps on a sewage collector to recover wastewater heat.
initiative.planned_outputs_text: Recovered wastewater heat supplying part of Wroclaw's district-heating demand.
initiative.delivery_text: FORTUM Power and Heat Polska Sp. z o.o. and the Municipal Water and Sewerage Company.

source_quote: WROMPA project.
